title: velocity action
description: Replaces the body with the result of a Velocity template: a DIL resource (velocity:ref:<name>) or a file. The template can use $body, $headers (also $headers.name), $in and $request (body and headers); the subset of Velocity that is supported is listed in the README, and a template that uses more does not compile.

resource.title: Template
resource.description: The template: the content of the resource the URI refers to, from dil.core.resources

path.title: Template file
path.description: Path of a file holding the template, read when the flow is loaded; set it or the resource
